title: A Tribute to the Voice of Apollo: Michael Forest

beats.text: Michael Forest has passed away at age 97, leaving behind a lifetime of stories.
Born in North Dakota in 1929, he moved to Seattle and studied drama and English.
His career began in 1953 and continued with active performances until the year 2020.
In 1967, he stepped into the stars as the god Apollo in a memorable television episode.
He returned to that same role nearly 46 years later, performing alongside his wife, Diana Hale.
Even at age 71, he lent his voice to Prince Olympius in Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue.
Beyond the screen, he shared his life with Diana for over fifty years of marriage.
He leaves a legacy of voices that traveled across planets and through time.
Follow Orbitwire for the stories the whole world is talking about.
